senses.d: Not different or other; not another or others; not different as regards self; selfsame; identical.
ex: I realised I was the same age as my grandfather had been when he joined the air force.
Even if the twins are identical, they are still not the same person, unlike Mark Twain and Samuel Clemens.

senses.d: Lacking variety from; indistinguishable.
Similar, alike.
ex: You have the same hair I do!

senses.d: Used to express the unity of an object or person which has various different descriptions or qualities.
ex: Round here it can be cloudy and sunny even in the same day.
We were all going in the same direction.

senses.d: A reply of confirmation of identity.
ex:
King Lear: This is a dull sight. Are you not Kent?
Kent: The same.

senses.d: The same way; in the same manner; to the same extent, unchanged; equally.
ex: A mother loves all her children the same.

ex: Large samples are generally more reliable than small samples due to having less variability.
